text: When the doctor wants to see a pet again, the visit team sends a follow-up to the CLs. This list is where they land.
Follow-ups the visit team sent to the CLs land in Needs booking.
The one thing to remember: every card ends booked, Book later, or removed. Work the oldest and highest priority first.
The card shows the pet, about when the doctor wants to see them, and with whom.
Log every call or text here. Everyone sees the same log.
Book opens routing with the follow-up filled in.
Choose the visit type. Scout asks every time, so the follow-up is booked as the right visit. Here it's a recheck.
Then book it like any visit: search, pick the time, and book.
Once it's booked, the card moves out of Needs booking.
If the family wants to wait, Book later. It comes back when it's time.
Mark complete is for a follow-up that was booked another way. Remove is for one that's no longer needed.

The most common mistakes: booking the visit from the calendar and leaving the card in Needs booking, and calling without logging it. Remember: every card ends booked, Book later, or removed. Work the oldest and highest priority first.
